verdicts.reason: A turns the design into a left-to-right banner with a strong headline, which suits the format. However, the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible speck on the far left. The headline is also so large that it nearly touches the top and bottom edges. The CTA wraps awkwardly onto two lines, is oversized enough to compete with the headline, and has a background dot overlapping 'Line'. B just shrinks the original's centred vertical stack into the middle of the banner and leaves the wide sides empty. Its 'Shop the Summer Line' CTA and the logo wordmark are tiny and hard to read at this size, so it ignores the banner format.
